title: What came between Ridda Wars and Umayyad campaigns in India?
question: What came between Ridda Wars and Umayyad campaigns in India?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Ridda Wars (632) to Umayyad campaigns in India (664): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
